body:
Scout's two courts accepted as measured.

Court 1: two different Inline records, one new EvidenceId, no ledger entry. NarrativeCompilerInput.of accepts. The validator checks Inline against input.evidence only when that map already has the id; it does not compare inlines to each other. canonicalBundle can sort the contradiction and distinctBy can pick one; no authority established they are one object.

Court 2 is the live defect. Same EvidenceId, different spans, two builds, same ClaimId narrative-claim:b2e77586a72d. ClaimId digests evidence ID strings, not evidence content. Meaning changed; identity did not. That is this repository's named class, occurring on main, not latent behind a caller convention.

R11 is therefore both: permutation-invariant canonical projection, and evidence identity/content validation before deduplication or claim construction. I already required the first-win refusal. This measurement says the compiler ClaimId door is already open.

I will not contest scout's volunteer. I will not implement. I will not take Q-A or Q-B.
